integrity: Analytic argument includes an exact feasibility inverse and a nonidentifiability family. Standard-library checker tests exact and floating-point special cases; tests do not substitute for universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless, calibrated, first-order nondepleting terminal sampler readings at exactly harmonic elimination rates; one strictly interior rectangular aqueous pulse. Sensitivity is a local partial derivative, not a finite-noise precision guarantee. Physical and independent external validation absent.
title: Three-rate passive-sampler pulse recovery and a universal short-pulse sensitivity law
